title: Quenching the Holy Spirit
definition: Quenching the Holy Spirit means resisting, suppressing, or disregarding the Spirit's work, especially through unbelief, disobedience, or rejection of God's Word.
summary: Believers are warned not to smother the Spirit's work through coldness, rebellion, neglect of Scripture, or refusal to obey.
christFocus: The Spirit exalts Christ, and quenching His work hinders faithful witness, worship, and obedience.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers are warned not to smother the Spirit's work through coldness, rebellion, neglect of Scripture, or refusal to obey.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
